typography.rules: Avoid default sans for headings. Use Outfit for a modern, technical POS feel. Use Poppins for readable body text, labels, and numbers. Headings must have tracking-tight.

layout_spacing.container: Mobile-first width (max-w-md mx-auto) for tablet/desktop to simulate a dedicated POS terminal screen. Full width on mobile.
layout_spacing.padding: Generous padding inside cards (p-4 to p-6).
layout_spacing.glassmorphism: bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 for cards, bottom bar, and dropdowns to add depth over the deep black.

header.style: Sticky top, z-50, backdrop-blur-lg bg-[#111111]/80 border-b border-white/10 p-4 flex justify-between items-center.
header.elements: App Title (LaundryMax Cashier) in Outfit Bold #FFD700, and circular User Profile Icon.

customer_dropdown.style: Shadcn Select or custom dropdown. bg-[#1A1A1A] border border-white/10 text-white. Focus rings must be #FFD700.
customer_dropdown.options: Walk-in (Harga Normal), Member Kostunpad (Harga Khusus - 10% Discount).

order_inputs.style: Bento-style grid or vertical list of items. Big +/- Counter buttons (w-12 h-12 bg-white/10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xl active:scale-90 transition-transform).

photo_button.style: Massive full-width button. p-6 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed border-[#FFD700]/50 bg-[#FFD700]/10 text-[#FFD700] flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-2 active:scale-[0.98] transition-all hover:bg-[#FFD700]/20.

sticky_bottom_bar.style: fixed bottom-0 max-w-md w-full p-4 md:p-6 backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#111111]/90 border-t border-white/10 flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-t-3xl shadow-[0_-10px_40px_rgba(0,0,0,0.5)] z-50.
sticky_bottom_bar.elements: Row 1: Total Harga label (muted) and Dynamic Price (large, bold #FFD700). Row 2: SIMPAN & CETAK QR CODE button (w-full p-4 bg-[#FFD700] text-black font-bold rounded-xl active:scale-95 transition-transform).

animations.micro_interactions: All buttons, counters, and tabs must have active:scale-95 or active:scale-90 transition-all duration-200.
animations.page_load: Framer motion staggered fade-up for list items.

media_urls.description: Professional avatar for the cashier logged into the POS

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement a pure mobile-first view (max-w-md mx-auto) with a very dark background (#111111) and bright yellow (#FFD700) accents. Use Outfit for headings and Poppins for the body. Apply subtle glassmorphism (bg-white/5 backdrop-blur-md) on internal cards to separate them from the pure black background. Ensure the bottom action bar is strictly fixed to the bottom and does not overlap scrollable content (add pb-32 to the main container). Implement all functionalities with interactive react state (dropdown selection, tabs, counter buttons, total price calculation). Do not use placeholder text for images; use the provided media_urls.
